exposure: Placental brain derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) gene expression
Macrosomia status (nondiabetic macrosomia vs. normal birth weight)
cohort: 58 nondiabetic macrosomic and 59 normal birth weight mother-infant pairs
finding: Neonates with nondiabetic macrosomia had lower placental BDNF gene expression and cord blood BDNF levels compared to normal birth weight neonates, suggesting a potential protective role of BDNF against macrosomia.
mod_finding: Cord blood BDNF was significantly lower in vaginally delivered macrosomic neonates compared to vaginally delivered controls, but there was no difference in cord BDNF between vaginal and cesarean delivery modes in macrosomic neonates.
